mechanism: Hadamard-lemma conjugation / virtual phase-space frame tracking (R commutes with n, rotates a and a^+ by a c-number phase)

rule.name: virtual_mode_frame_tracking_push_R_through_phase_gates
rule.idea: R_a(theta)=exp(-i theta n_a) commutes with n_a and rotates a, a^+ by a c-number phase. Walking the routed circuit in time order, each R on a mode is deleted and folded into a pending per-mode frame angle; every subsequent gate touching that mode (D, CD, RB, BS/CBS) is re-parameterized by the exact conjugation identity (R^+ a R = e^{-i theta} a), while R/CR/CP on the same mode commute and pass through untouched. Any unrecognized gate on the mode forces a flush of the pending R just before it. At the end of the circuit one residual R per mode is emitted (omitted if it reduces to the identity mod 2 pi). This removes the compensating R's from every router SWAP block and the native R terms without adding or removing any two-qubit/qumode gate, so the 2-op count and critical structure are unchanged while the 1-op count and critical-path duration drop.
